name: pendex
description: Pendex turns an entire source tree into portable, plain-text archives — ideal for AI prompts, code reviews backups, and sharing. Compile a project into banner-delimited `.txt` files grouped by job (source, web, style, terminal, configuration, documentation, testing, misc), then reconstruct the whole tree later with `px split`.

scripts.fmt: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force logs | Out-Null; oxfmt 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 logs/oxfmt.log"
scripts.fmt:check: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force logs | Out-Null; oxfmt --check2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 logs/oxfmt-check.log"
scripts.lint: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force logs | Out-Null; oxlint | Out-File -Encoding utf8 logs/oxlint.log"
scripts.lint:fix: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force logs | Out-Null; oxlint --fix --type-aware --type-check | Out-File -Encoding utf8 logs/oxlint-types-fix.log"
scripts.lint:types: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force logs | Out-Null; oxlint --type-aware --type-check | Out-File -Encoding utf8 logs/oxlint-types.log"
scripts.typecheck: bun run lint:types; bun run --workspaces typecheck
scripts.git:push: git add . && git commit -m 'Updates' && git push origin main
